meta.name: ai-copy-editing
meta.description: 转化实验助手适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营、内容媒体在用户提出“这个改动值得测吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成内容诊断、结构化优化建议、可执行发布清单。

copy.tagline: 快速诊断内容并生成可执行的优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要判断内容改动是否值得测试并快速落地优化。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose content and generate actionable optimization plans quickly.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to decide whether content changes are worth testing and quickly implement improvements.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的内容目标、受众、草稿或链接，输出内容诊断、结构化优化建议和可执行发布清单，帮你判断改动是否值得测试。
howto.when: 当你提出“这个改动值得测吗”这类问题，或需要围绕内容目标生成诊断、优化建议和发布清单时触发。

say.text: 这个标题改动值得测吗？
say.note: Claude 会分析并给出诊断和建议。

say.text: 帮我优化这篇文案，目标受众是年轻职场人。
say.note: Claude 会结合受众生成优化建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your content goal, audience, draft, or links, and outputs content diagnosis, structured optimization suggestions, and an actionable publishing checklist to help decide if a change is worth testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like 'Is this change worth testing?' or need diagnosis, optimization suggestions, and a publishing checklist for content goals.

say_en.text: Is this headline change worth testing?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and provide diagnosis and suggestions.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this copy targeting young professionals.
say_en.note: Claude will generate optimization suggestions based on the audience.
